title: Docker lab: images, containers, volumes and Compose
summary: One server with Docker Engine and the Compose plugin, the lab user in the docker group. The exercises read the engine, run and inspect containers, step inside them, keep data in volumes and bind mounts, bring up a small Compose app and build an image from a Dockerfile. The two images they use (alpine:3.20, nginx:1.27-alpine) are pre-pulled by the install, so nothing waits on Docker Hub. Ported from qlab's docker-lab.

exercises.title: Docker anatomy
exercises.text: The engine is a daemon (dockerd) the docker CLI talks to over a Unix socket; membership of the docker group is what lets the lab user use it without sudo.

commands: id -nG | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -x docker    # why no sudo is needed

exercises.title: Images and containers
exercises.text: An image is the read-only template, a container a running (or stopped) instance of it with its own writable layer.

commands: docker run --rm --pull never alpine:3.20 cat /etc/os-release    # a one-shot container, removed when it ends

exercises.title: Inside a running container
exercises.text: exec starts a second process in a running container, logs reads what its main process printed, inspect shows how it was configured.

commands: docker exec -it lab-web sh    # a shell inside: ls /usr/share/nginx/html, exit to leave
docker rm -f lab-web    # stop and remove

exercises.title: Volumes and bind mounts
exercises.text: A container's own layer disappears with it; a named volume (managed by Docker) or a bind mount (a host directory) keeps the data.

commands: docker run --rm --pull never -v lab-data:/data alpine:3.20 sh -c 'echo kept > /data/note'
docker run --rm --pull never -v lab-data:/data alpine:3.20 cat /data/note    # a second container reads it
mkdir -p ~/bind && docker run --rm --pull never -v ~/bind:/out alpine:3.20 sh -c 'date > /out/stamp' && cat ~/bind/stamp

exercises.title: A Compose app
exercises.text: Compose describes several containers, their ports and volumes in one file and brings them up and down together.

commands:
cat > ~/compose-demo/compose.yaml <<'EOF'
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    pull_policy: never
    ports:
      - "8081:80"
    volumes:
      - ./html:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
EOF
cd ~/compose-demo && docker compose up -d && docker compose ps

exercises.title: Build an image from a Dockerfile
exercises.text: Each instruction of a Dockerfile is a layer on top of the base image; the result is an image like the others.

commands: docker image rm lab-hello && cd && rm -rf ~/build-demo
